prompt: Single continuous shot. Eight eggs cracked in rapid rhythm into a bowl, whisked into a golden vortex. Broccoli and tomato scattered across a baking dish like confetti, the egg poured over in a slow flood, cheese falling. Money shot: the puffed golden slab emerging from the oven, cut into perfect squares with a knife in one motion, one square lifted with steam pouring off, backlit. Final beat: six containers in a row, one square in each. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the rhythmic cracks, then the knife cuts. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Um forno, seis marmitas — a omelete de forno que rende a semana.
🧾 8 ovos · 1 xíc. de leite · brócolis picado · tomate · queijo · o legume que tiver
1. Bate ovos e leite. 2. Espalha os legumes numa assadeira untada, despeja os ovos. 3. Forno 180° por 25 min, corta em 6 quadrados.
💡 Congela embalado individualmente — 2 min de micro-ondas em qualquer manhã da semana. Salva pro domingo 📌
